body:
Share **41 guarded bulk kernels and 40 direct integer operations** with interpreter and C1 on x86-64 and AArch64. `UseCommonIntrinsics` defaults to enabled on these architectures; existing intrinsic flags and Java fallbacks remain in force.

- Use scalar assembler and existing stubs through bounded, allocation-free C++ leaves, preserving evaluation order and reexecution state.
- Route methods containing breakpoints through the ordinary interpreter, including breakpoint-only JVMTI debugging.
- Resolve bootstrap field offsets without metadata-handle allocation; preserve sequential Java behavior for aliased Keccak states.
- Record C1 guard failures per bytecode site, including inlined scopes and level-1 compilations.
- Defer compiler-stub generation until a relevant class is linked after bootstrap, outside the leaf adapters. Serialize publication with C2 initialization and retain the original fast lookup paths.
- Fix the shared x64 polynomial-assignment stub's Windows `r9` length/scratch collision. Test generic lengths, selection, aliasing and the public two-limb polynomial API.

The [391-entry audit and integration notes](https://github.com/re-thc/openjdk-jdk27u/blob/common-intrinsics/doc/common-intrinsics/README.md) preserve existing integrations and the boundaries of PRs #2–#6 and #10. Base64 and Unicode acceleration are excluded.

### Benchmarks

Current implementation `8bf01e9ed8a` versus **unmodified master `87edd79d3104`**, using default flag settings. Linux x64 AMD EPYC 9V74, GCC 16.2, JMH 1.37, three alternating fresh-JVM pairs with a pinned worker. Values are speedups for selected workloads.

| Workload | Input | Interpreter | C1 |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: |
| AES-256 CTR | 4 KiB | 1288.29× | 106.95× |
| SHA-256 | 4 KiB | 229.42× | 11.87× |
| SHA3-256 | 4 KiB | 68.99× | 2.66× |
| byte[] hash | 4 KiB | 20.77× | 2.32× |
| BigInteger multiply | 4,096 bits | 14.12× | 4.33× |
| BigInteger modPow | 4,096 bits | 23.78× | 6.58× |
| long bitCount | scalar | 2.04× | 6.06× |

C2 controls establish no slowdown in these cases. Longer six-pair multiplication and SHA-256 controls give paired 95% changes of −155.92 to +239.52 ns and −45.76 to −4.63 ns respectively.

Warm startup uses 600 balanced blocks per mode, comparing master, modified flag-off and flag-on. Changes against master are −0.092 ms for interpreter (95% interval −0.324 to +0.141), +0.119 ms for C1 (−0.150 to +0.387), and +0.078 ms for C2 (−0.138 to +0.293). Both libraries were prepared identically with unchanged hashes to control an observed local loading bias. The independent native CI run also shows no resolved slowdown against master. Its x64 flag-off/on interpreter comparison measures +0.051 ms (95% interval +0.013 to +0.090), so zero enabled-path cost is not established.

[Full results, uncertainty, loading controls and reproduction](https://github.com/re-thc/openjdk-jdk27u/blob/common-intrinsics/doc/common-intrinsics/BENCHMARKS.md) include separately labeled historical ARM and mixed-guard measurements.

### Validation

- **136 final x64 jtreg records passed:** 20 common-intrinsic records per release/fastdebug build, 74 JDK crypto, 11 related HotSpot crypto/BigInteger, 10 AOT/CDS/code-cache, and one flagless metaspace/CDS record.
- Fastdebug uses `CheckUnhandledOops` and `VerifyOops`. AVX-512 tests require native Keccak execution and cover shifts, boundaries and aliases in interpreter and C1 levels 1 and 3.
- A Microsoft x64 ABI assembly probe reproduces the original polynomial failure and passes the corrected loop. This is Linux probe evidence, not a Windows PR-JVM run.
- The complete applicability audit and official include-order checker pass. [Pinned evidence and binary fingerprints](https://github.com/re-thc/openjdk-jdk27u/tree/08e855a448acda54c7b1872c286443495503f11a/.github/qualification/final-x64) remain outside the PR diff.
- The [code-identical Linux run](https://github.com/re-thc/openjdk-jdk27u/actions/runs/38385226401) passed all four release/debug builds and 23 of 24 tier1 selections. AArch64 runtime failed `FourByteHeaderArchiveDeterminism.java#z` at archive byte 1,785,800. [Baseline/PR reproduction](https://github.com/re-thc/openjdk-jdk27u/actions/runs/38640541680) is queued; the failure is not yet attributed. The docs-only head has no new CI run.
- [Windows/macOS release/debug builds](https://github.com/re-thc/openjdk-jdk27u/actions/runs/38393501715) passed; their tier1 jobs were skipped. [Targeted native tests and master comparisons](https://github.com/re-thc/openjdk-jdk27u/actions/runs/38397336007) passed on x64 and AArch64. Windows AVX-512 execution and tier2 remain unqualified.
